free-ride-start.text: Let's ride! Smooth pedal strokes, find your rhythm, and let's stack those Burn Points!

ten-seconds.text: Ten seconds! Get ready to switch!

burn-first.text: First Burn Point on the board! Keep that fire going!

burn-twelve.text: Twelve Burn Points! Target crushed! Keep pushing!

workout-complete.text: Workout complete! Amazing effort today! Spin your legs out easy and grab some water.

cue-warmup.text: Warm-up spin! Smooth, easy pedal strokes as we wake up the legs.

cue-base.text: Base pace! Lock into a steady, strong Green zone rhythm.

cue-push.text: Push pace! Add resistance and drive right into the Orange zone!

cue-all-out.text: All out! Empty the tank, fast legs, let's go!

cue-recovery.text: Active recovery! Dial the gear down, deep breaths, flush out the legs.

seg-w1.text: Welcome to your twenty-three minute Signature Burn! Smooth warm-up spin, bring that heart rate into Blue and early Green!

seg-b1.text: Base pace settle! Challenging but doable, lock into a solid Green zone!

seg-p1.text: Two-minute Push pace! Add two to three clicks of resistance and drive into Orange!

seg-b2.text: Back to Base! Hold steady Green power while controlling your breathing.

seg-p2.text: Ninety-second threshold Push! Right around your F T P, let's build those Orange Burn minutes!

seg-ao1.text: Thirty seconds All-Out surge! Empty the tank, fast legs, straight into the Burn Zone!

seg-r1.text: Nice work! Active recovery. Dial the resistance down, deep breaths, flush the legs.

seg-p3.text: Three-minute heavy Push climb! Add heavy gear and drive muscular torque, seated or standing!

seg-b3.text: Base flat road! Take off that climb gear and spin briskly in Green.

seg-p4.text: Sixty-second final Push! Set up the finisher, hold high Orange!

seg-ao2.text: Forty-five second finisher All-Out! Everything left in the legs, finish strong!

seg-cd1.text: Awesome push! Cool-down flush. Easy spin and let that heart rate float down.

seg-h-wu.text: Let's go! Twenty-minute Burn Express! Progressive warm-up, add a click of gear each minute to wake up the legs!

seg-h-push-1.text: Round one of five, Push! Sixty seconds right at threshold, let's light it up!

seg-h-ao-1.text: Round one, All-Out! Thirty seconds max snap, go, go, go!

seg-h-rec-1.text: Round one done! Sixty seconds easy spin, catch your breath.

seg-h-push-2.text: Round two, Push! Back on the gas, drive into Orange!

seg-h-ao-2.text: Round two, All-Out! Thirty seconds fast legs, attack it!

seg-h-rec-2.text: Nice job! Dial it down, smooth recovery spin.

seg-h-push-3.text: Round three, halfway there! Strong threshold Push, hold that power!

seg-h-ao-3.text: Round three, All-Out! Thirty seconds, push the pace!

seg-h-rec-3.text: Awesome! Easy gear, deep breaths, two rounds left.

seg-h-push-4.text: Round four, Push! Dig in right here, stack those Burn Points!

seg-h-ao-4.text: Round four, All-Out! Thirty seconds explosive power!

seg-h-rec-4.text: One final round ahead! Spin light and reset.

seg-h-push-5.text: Final round, five of five! Strong sixty-second Push, set up the finish!

seg-h-ao-5.text: Last All-Out of the day! Thirty seconds, empty the tank all the way to the line!

seg-h-rec-5.text: You crushed all five rounds! Easy recovery spin, catch your breath.

seg-h-cd.text: Smooth cool-down spin! Let your breathing settle, great work today!

seg-p-wu.text: Welcome to the thirty-minute Power Pyramid! Four-minute prep spin, settle into a smooth cadence.

seg-p-s1.text: Step one, Sweet Spot Base! Controlled Green aerobic power, nice and steady.

seg-p-s2.text: Step two, Threshold Climb! Add heavy resistance and hold strong threshold torque!

seg-p-peak.text: Pyramid Summit! Two minutes strong right over F T P, crest this climb!

seg-p-valley.text: You made the summit! Valley recovery spin, grab a sip of water and spin light.

seg-p-d2.text: Step down the pyramid, Fast Threshold! Same Push watts, quicker leg speed!

seg-p-d1.text: Tempo cruise! Settle into a strong, steady Green rhythm.

seg-p-fin.text: Sixty-second sprint kick! Final surge to the line, give it everything you've got!

seg-p-cd.text: Phenomenal climb! Cool-down spin, dial the resistance way down.

seg-e-wu.text: Forty-five minute Zone two and three cruise! Easy five-minute warm-up into the Blue zone.

seg-e-b1.text: Aerobic Base block one! Lock in a smooth Green endurance rhythm and enjoy your show!

seg-e-p1.text: Mid-ride tempo opener! Five-minute brisk Push to wake up those legs!

seg-e-b2.text: Aerobic Base block two! Smooth conversational Green zone cruise all the way home.

seg-e-cd.text: Final cool-down spin! Easy pedals, great endurance session today!
